text.p: Here are the main reports from the Estonian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The security police have arrested a group of persons suspected of involvement in the illegal arms trade and the production of amphetamines.
- Transport firm Tallinna Autoveod has lost over 1.5 million kroons through customs fraud.
- The EMEX scrap metal firm launched a new metal processing plant on Wednesday.
- The security police says the Centre Party has lied about the source of its election funds, an allegation denied by the party.
- The Coalition Party will support incumbent Lennart Meri in the September 20 presidential election.
- Democratic Labour Party chairman Vaino Viljas has said he will not enter the September 20 presidential race.
